The '''Malignant Bog''' was a swamp located south of [[the Wall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. It was the site of several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tombs, and was home to a large number of hostile [[yozusk]]s, [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], [[Sleen/Legends|sleens]], and [[vine cat]]s.
